Make prediction table

Source: R/utils-getpred.R
make_pred_table.Rd

Check to see if inputs to 'get prediction' are valid

Usage

make_pred_table(object, agegroups, standpop, byage, incidence, excludeobs)

Arguments

object

"adpcproj", "hybdproj", or "acproj" object

agegroups

Age groups to include. "all" (default) includes all age groups, and individual groups can be selected by group number. E.g. c(1:3, 7) includes the first 3 groups and the seventh group.

standpop

A StandardPopulation object that provides the weights (proportions) for each age groups in a standard population.

byage

Report numbers by age groups (T), or use age-standardized rates (F).

incidence

Whether to give rates (T) or numbers (F).

excludeobs

Whether to include observed values (T or F).
